items.html: Now, since in their joining they became one single Partzuf, it is found that what was at first the Rosh of Tvuna is now the foundation and base of the totality of the two Partzufim in their being one single Partzuf. And what was at first the Yesod of Bina is now the Chazeh [chest] of Bina of the phase of the totality of the single Partzuf alone. For behold, the Rosh of Tvuna was at first in what is now the lower third of Tifferet, which is the place of the belly of the totality now.
